pervers.r1_d: Based on your answers, your relationship doesn't show the markers of narcissistic abuse. Like every couple you have disagreements and clumsy moments, but your partner respects your word, your limits and your freedom. Emotional safety seems to be there.
pervers.r1_a: Keep nurturing what works: dialogue, mutual respect and listening. If a doubt lingered despite this reassuring result, trust your gut and don't hesitate to talk about it with people around you.
pervers.r2_t: A few signals to keep an eye on
pervers.r2_d: Some of your answers point to behaviours that deserve your attention: occasional put-downs, difficulty owning mistakes, or moments when you feel on the defensive. This doesn't necessarily make your partner a narcissist, but these dynamics can take root if nothing is named.
pervers.r2_a: Dare to set a clear limit and watch the reaction: a respectful partner adjusts, a manipulator escalates. Keep a factual journal of what hurts you to see things more clearly, and talk to someone you trust.
pervers.r3_d: Several of your answers describe mechanisms typical of coercive control: gaslighting, reversed guilt, isolation, the idealise / devalue cycle. You may be walking on eggshells and doubting your own perception. Repeated, these patterns deeply damage self-esteem.
pervers.r3_a: This result deserves to be taken seriously. Reconnect with reality by keeping a journal of the facts, break the isolation and, ideally, get support from a professional (a psychologist or a specialised organisation). You are not responsible for the other person's behaviour.
pervers.r4_t: A profile strongly suggestive of a narcissist
pervers.r4_d: Your answers paint a worrying picture, very close to the mechanics of narcissistic abuse: manipulation, lack of empathy, control, blackmail and the gradual destruction of your self-confidence. This kind of relationship is exhausting and can endanger your mental, sometimes physical, health.
pervers.r4_a: Don't carry this weight alone. Reach out to a professional and to organisations that support victims of psychological abuse. In case of immediate danger, contact the emergency services. This test is not a diagnosis, but it confirms one thing: you have every right to protect yourself.
pervers.q1: At the very start of your relationship, how would you describe their behaviour?
pervers.q1a: They got to know me gradually, at my own pace, without rushing.
pervers.q1b: Attentive, with a few intense bursts that felt sincere.
pervers.q1c: Everything moved very fast: 'soulmate' talk, passionate declarations, immediate plans.
pervers.q1d: They showered me with attention… then changed abruptly once I was attached.
pervers.q2: When they make a hurtful remark about you in front of other people…
pervers.q2a: It doesn't happen: they're careful never to humiliate me in public.
pervers.q2b: It's rare, and they apologise sincerely afterwards.
pervers.q2c: They throw digs 'as a joke' and say I have no sense of humour if I'm upset.
pervers.q2d: They belittle me often, then make me look oversensitive or dramatic.
pervers.q3: When you point out something they said or did, their typical reaction is…
pervers.q3a: They listen, own their part, and we talk it through calmly.
pervers.q3b: They get defensive at first, but end up admitting the facts.
pervers.q3c: They flatly deny it: 'I never said that, you're making it up.'
pervers.q3d: They make me doubt my memory and my sanity ('you're paranoid', 'you're imagining things').
pervers.q4: Since you've been together, your relationships with your loved ones (friends, family)…
pervers.q4a: Have grown richer: they get along well with the people close to me.
pervers.q4c: Have thinned out: they often criticise my friends or family.
pervers.q4d: Have shrunk a lot: I see my loved ones far less to avoid tension.
pervers.q5: When you're sad or going through a hard time, they…
pervers.q5a: Support me and genuinely try to comfort me.
pervers.q5b: Aren't always comfortable with it, but make an effort to be there.
pervers.q5c: Minimise what I feel or quickly turn the conversation back to themselves.
pervers.q5d: Stay cold, even annoyed, as if my pain were an inconvenience.
pervers.q6: After a conflict, who ends up apologising?
pervers.q6a: Whoever was wrong, and often both of us.
pervers.q6b: Often me, but they acknowledge their mistakes too.
pervers.q6c: Almost always me, even when I did nothing wrong.
pervers.q6d: Always me: they cast themselves as the victim, never as responsible.
pervers.q7: When it comes to your personal choices (spending, clothes, going out, free time)…
pervers.q7a: I decide freely; we talk about the things that concern us both.
pervers.q7b: They give their opinion, but respect my choices.
pervers.q7c: They apply pressure: I self-censor to avoid reproaches.
pervers.q7d: They control my money, my clothes or my schedule.
pervers.q8: The partner your friends know and the one you live with at home…
pervers.q8a: Are the same person, consistent in every situation.
pervers.q8b: Are quite alike, with small, normal differences.
pervers.q8c: Differ: they're far more charming in public than with me.
pervers.q8d: Are two opposite people: lovely outside, contemptuous or harsh in private.
pervers.q9: When they're displeased with you, the way they show it is…
pervers.q9a: To talk about it openly to resolve the problem.
pervers.q9b: To sulk for a while, then come back to me.
pervers.q9c: To give me the cold shoulder and punish me with silence for hours.
pervers.q9d: To ignore me completely for days until I give in and apologise.
pervers.q10: Day to day, at home, you feel mostly…
pervers.q10a: Relaxed and free to be myself.
pervers.q10b: At ease, with the normal tensions of living together.
pervers.q10c: On guard: I anticipate their moods to avoid outbursts.
pervers.q10d: In a constant state of alert: I feel like I'm 'walking on eggshells'.
pervers.q11: Faced with clear proof of a lie or wrongdoing, they…
pervers.q11b: Are embarrassed, but end up admitting it.
pervers.q11c: Come up with a twisted excuse or minimise it.
pervers.q11d: Keep denying against the evidence, or turn the accusation back on me.
pervers.q12: When you have a success (work, a project, a compliment)…
pervers.q12a: They're proud of me and show it.
pervers.q12b: They're happy for me, even if not always demonstrative.
pervers.q12c: They play it down or find a flaw in my success.
pervers.q12d: They get jealous, sulk, or find a way to spoil the moment.
pervers.q13: When you bring up the idea of taking a step back or leaving…
pervers.q13a: They respect my need for space and we talk about it.
pervers.q13b: They're sad, but they hear me.
pervers.q13c: They guilt-trip me ('after everything I've done for you').
pervers.q13d: They threaten me: breakup as punishment, blackmail, 'I won't survive it', threats towards themselves or me.
pervers.q14: Do they use other people (an ex, colleagues, strangers) within your relationship?
pervers.q14b: Rarely, and with no intent to hurt me.
pervers.q14c: They compare me to others or trigger my jealousy 'to test' me.
pervers.q14d: They accuse me of cheating for no reason, while keeping doubt or ambiguity alive themselves.
pervers.q15: Does your relationship feel like an emotional rollercoaster?
pervers.q15a: No, it's rather stable and reassuring.
pervers.q15b: There are ups and downs, like in any couple.
pervers.q15c: Yes: intense, all-consuming phases followed by cold breakups.
pervers.q15d: Yes, an exhausting cycle: they idealise me, tear me down, then come back the moment I pull away.
pervers.q16: When they promise to change after a crisis…
pervers.q16a: The change is real and it lasts.
pervers.q16b: They make an effort, with a few relapses.
pervers.q16c: It holds for a few days, then it all starts again.
pervers.q16d: Nothing ever changes: the promises only exist to make me stay.
pervers.q17: Since this relationship began, your self-confidence has…
pervers.q17d: Collapsed: I don't recognise myself anymore, I've lost who I was.
pervers.q18: In your relationship, the effort and the sacrifices…
pervers.q18a: Are balanced between the two of us.
pervers.q18b: Lean a little towards my side, but it stays fair.
pervers.q18c: Fall mainly on me (time, money, energy).
pervers.q18d: Are entirely one-way: I feel used with nothing in return.
pervers.q19: What do your loved ones say about your relationship?
pervers.q19a: They think it's healthy and are happy for me.
pervers.q19b: They don't have a particular opinion.
pervers.q19c: Some are worried or have already warned me.
pervers.q19d: Several have raised the alarm, but I downplay it or hide the reality from them.
pervers.q20: Today, the idea of leaving this relationship…
pervers.q20a: Isn't on the table: I feel good in it.
pervers.q20b: Crosses my mind sometimes, like in any couple.
pervers.q20c: Haunts me, but I feel unable to take the step.
pervers.q20d: Terrifies me: I know this relationship hurts me, but I feel 'addicted' and trapped.
